Parameter.Plugins: A CSV of TinyMCE plugin names to load (e.g. 'advlist, autolink, lists, link, image, table, code').
Parameter.Toolbar: The toolbar configuration string defining which buttons and groups to display (e.g. 'undo redo | blocks | bold italic forecolor | bullist numlist | table | code').
Parameter.ResourceURL: The base URL where the TinyMCE distribution is served (must contain tinymce.min.js, skins/, icons/, models/ and plugins/ subdirectories).
Parameter.UploadURL: The server endpoint URL for file uploads (e.g. TTBoard_UPLOAD?uid=). Used by the codbiuploadfile toolbar button.
Parameter.UploadImageURL: The server endpoint URL for image uploads. Falls back to UploadURL if not set.
Parameter.UploadFieldName: The name of the form field for the uploaded file (default: fileToUpload).
Parameter.StripPort: If set to 'true', the port number (e.g. :444) is removed from the URL returned by the upload server before inserting it into the editor.
Parameter.RenderToPdf: If set to 'true', a print-listener is registered that replaces the document body with the plain-text content of this editor when the form is printed/exported to PDF.

Plugins.description: A CSV of TinyMCE plugin names to load (e.g. 'advlist, autolink, lists, link, image, table, code').
Plugins.descriptionDe: Eine CSV der zu ladenden TinyMCE-Plugin-Namen (z. B. 'advlist, autolink, lists, link, image, table, code').
Plugins.descriptionIt: Un CSV dei nomi dei plugin TinyMCE da caricare (es. 'advlist, autolink, lists, link, image, table, code').

Toolbar.description: The toolbar configuration string defining which buttons and groups to display (e.g. 'undo redo | blocks | bold italic forecolor | bullist numlist | table | code').
Toolbar.descriptionDe: Die Toolbar-Konfigurationszeichenfolge, die definiert, welche Buttons und Gruppen angezeigt werden (z. B. 'undo redo | blocks | bold italic forecolor | bullist numlist | table | code').
Toolbar.descriptionIt: La stringa di configurazione della toolbar che definisce quali pulsanti e gruppi mostrare (es. 'undo redo | blocks | bold italic forecolor | bullist numlist | table | code').

ResourceURL.description: The base URL where the TinyMCE distribution is served (must contain tinymce.min.js, skins/, icons/, models/ and plugins/ subdirectories).
ResourceURL.descriptionDe: Die Basis-URL, unter der die TinyMCE-Distribution bereitgestellt wird (muss tinymce.min.js, skins/, icons/, models/ und plugins/-Unterverzeichnisse enthalten).
ResourceURL.descriptionIt: L'URL di base in cui viene servita la distribuzione TinyMCE (deve contenere tinymce.min.js e le sottodirectory skins/, icons/, models/ e plugins/).

UploadURL.description: The server endpoint URL for file uploads (e.g. TTBoard_UPLOAD?uid=). Used by the codbiuploadfile toolbar button.
UploadURL.descriptionDe: Die Server-Endpunkt-URL für Datei-Uploads (z. B. TTBoard_UPLOAD?uid=). Wird vom Toolbar-Button codbiuploadfile verwendet.
UploadURL.descriptionIt: L'URL dell'endpoint del server per i caricamenti di file (es. TTBoard_UPLOAD?uid=). Usata dal pulsante toolbar codbiuploadfile.

UploadImageURL.description: The server endpoint URL for image uploads. Falls back to UploadURL if not set.
UploadImageURL.descriptionDe: Die Server-Endpunkt-URL für Bild-Uploads. Fällt auf UploadURL zurück, wenn nicht gesetzt.
UploadImageURL.descriptionIt: L'URL dell'endpoint del server per i caricamenti di immagini. Torna a UploadURL se non impostata.

UploadFieldName.description: The name of the form field for the uploaded file (default: fileToUpload).
UploadFieldName.descriptionDe: Der Name des Formularfelds für die hochgeladene Datei (Standard: fileToUpload).
UploadFieldName.descriptionIt: Il nome del campo del modulo per il file caricato (predefinito: fileToUpload).

StripPort.description: If set to 'true', the port number (e.g. :444) is removed from the URL returned by the upload server before inserting it into the editor.
StripPort.descriptionDe: Wenn auf 'true' gesetzt, wird die Portnummer (z. B. :444) aus der vom Upload-Server zurückgegebenen URL entfernt, bevor sie in den Editor eingefügt wird.
StripPort.descriptionIt: Se impostato su 'true', il numero di porta (es. :444) viene rimosso dall'URL restituita dal server di upload prima di inserirla nell'editor.

RenderToPdf.description: If set to 'true', a print-listener is registered that replaces the document body with the plain-text content of this editor when the form is printed/exported to PDF.
RenderToPdf.descriptionDe: Wenn auf 'true' gesetzt, wird ein Druck-Listener registriert, der den Dokumentkörper beim Drucken/Exportieren in PDF durch den Klartextinhalt dieses Editors ersetzt.
RenderToPdf.descriptionIt: Se impostato su 'true', viene registrato un listener di stampa che sostituisce il corpo del documento con il contenuto di testo semplice di questo editor quando il modulo viene stampato/esportato in PDF.
